question: Does the current exact raw-byte representation substrate preserve learned behavior when the same logical values and operations are expressed through independently recurring surface aliases that are never explicitly identified as equivalent?
hypothesis: If the current substrate has learned surface-invariant abstractions rather than exact recurring byte motifs, training two complete alias families independently should permit cross-family value/operation combinations to retain at least 0.90 semantic transition accuracy. If same-family accuracy is at least 0.95 but cross-family accuracy is at most 0.25 with cross-family transition keys absent, the current representation mechanism is falsified as surface-invariant and should be treated as exact-motif dependent.

portfolio_context.allocation: 75% chain / 25% substrate falsification over the current prospective block
portfolio_context.reason: challenge whether recent raw-representation successes reflect invariant learned structure or exact surface recurrence

prior_evidence.observation: Nine exact recurring raw motifs were recovered and learned primitive transitions composed perfectly across 192 unseen multi-step programs.

scope_statement: This experiment attacks surface-form invariance only. It does not reinterpret prior supported results; it tests a stronger abstraction claim that those results did not establish.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

benchmark.single_step_training: for each alias family independently, all five semantic operations on all sixteen semantic value pairs, repeated twenty times
benchmark.cross_family_cases: values expressed in family 0 with operation in family 1, plus values in family 1 with operation in family 0
benchmark.noise: deterministic LCG upper-bit bytes in range 192..255; no semantic identity or alias-equivalence information is encoded in noise

representation_learner.candidate: every contiguous four-byte window within each training record
representation_learner.selection: top eighteen by occurrence count descending, then lexicographic raw key

transition_learner.state: exact learned surface-operation representation plus exact ordered learned surface-value pair -> observed surface-output-pair counts
transition_learner.prediction: argmax learned surface-output pair for the exact surface transition key; unseen keys tie to the lowest surface-output pair
transition_learner.semantic_scoring: only the evaluator maps predicted surface value motifs back to their known semantic values after prediction

controls: Both alias families receive complete same-family training at identical cardinality.
The representation learner receives no evaluator alias pairing or semantic label.
The transition learner receives decoded surface representations only and is never given semantic alias equivalence.
Same-family evaluation verifies that each surface family was independently learned before cross-family falsification is interpreted.
Cross-family evaluation changes only the combination of already-trained surface aliases; semantic operations and value pairs remain within the trained logical support.
No tokenizer, external model, network access, gradient optimizer, capacity growth, oracle correction, alias dictionary, or post-result tuning is permitted.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
Both surface families contain four value aliases and five operation aliases, and both are fully trained independently.
Exactly 3200 raw single-step training records, 160 same-family controls, and 160 cross-family evaluations complete.
The representation learner selects raw motifs without evaluator alias-equivalence information.
The transition learner uses exact surface representation identities and receives no semantic alias mapping.
Same-family and cross-family semantic accuracy are scored only after prediction by evaluator-only mapping.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, alias dictionary, threshold change, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.survives_falsification: Validity passes, same-family accuracy is at least 0.95, cross-family accuracy is at least 0.90, and no cross-family transition key is missing.
classification_rules.surface_invariance_falsified: Validity passes, same-family accuracy is at least 0.95, cross-family accuracy is at most 0.25, and cross-family missing transition count is greater than zero.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and same-family learning succeeds, but cross-family behavior lies between the survives-falsification and surface-invariance-falsified criteria.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Same-family accuracy is below 0.95, so alias-invariance interpretation is not valid.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the full frozen matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any representation, alias-isolation, evaluator-boundary, deterministic-state, capacity, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before scientific execution on parent, North Star, build, frozen-package, or alias-construction drift.
After output begins, complete all same-family and cross-family evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not add alias-merging logic, increase capacity, alter motifs, change scoring, or weaken thresholds after observing output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No alias family, representation rule, transition state, evaluation pairing, metric, threshold, or interpretation may change after any primary output is observed under this experiment identifier.
